queries.description: Newest 24-hour page without a dimension filter.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  logs.id::text AS id,
  to_char(
    logs."timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'
  ) AS timestamp,
  logs.level,
  logs.service,
  logs.message,
  logs.attributes
FROM logstream.logs AS logs
WHERE "timestamp" >= $1::timestamptz AND "timestamp" < $2::timestamptz
ORDER BY logs."timestamp" DESC, logs.id DESC
LIMIT $3::integer

queries.description: Representative 24-hour, five-minute aggregation grouped by service.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  to_char(
    aggregation.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'
  ) AS start,
  aggregation.group_value AS "group",
  aggregation.count::text AS count
FROM (
  SELECT
    date_bin(
      INTERVAL '5 minutes',
      logs."timestamp",
      TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    ) AS bucket_start,
    logs.service AS group_value,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM logstream.logs AS logs
  WHERE "timestamp" >= $1::timestamptz AND "timestamp" < $2::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) AS aggregation
ORDER BY aggregation.bucket_start ASC, aggregation.group_value ASC
